title: Senior Field Operations Lead
text: The Fictional Interplanetary Civic Liaison Office in Berlin seeks a Senior Field Operations Lead. Lead field teams through complex public-space incidents, coordinate railway and medical partners, maintain defensible evidence handling and turn exercises into practical operating improvements. Explain deployment authority and collaboration with specialist teams. Supervisory coaching and cross-cultural communication are required. A quantified exercise improvement is helpful if reliably evidenced. Orbital pilot licensing is optional and must not be inferred. Submit a CV and a Germany-market cover letter in English and German.
